movelist.name: Defense Curl
movelist.effect: The user’s Defense is raised 1 Combat Stage and they become Curled Up until the end of the Scene or they are Recalled or Take a Breather. When using the Moves Rollout or Ice Ball while Curled Up, the user gains a +10 bonus to the damage rolls of those Moves.

movelist.name: Odor Sleuth
movelist.effect: Odor Sleuth may be activated as a Swift Action on the user’s turn. For the rest of the turn, the user’s Normal-Type and Fighting-Type Moves can hit and affect Ghost-Type targets, and the user can see through the Illusion Ability, Moves with the Illusion keyword, and effects created by the Illusionist Capability, ignoring all effects from those.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Lick
movelist.effect: Lick Paralyzes the target on 15+ during Accuracy Check.

movelist.name: Amnesia
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.effect: The user resists Fire-Type and Ice-Type attacks one step further. Defensive.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: You may use Pickup as an Extended Action that requires at least 5 minutes. Roll 1d20, consult the Pickup keyword to figure out what you find!
